applies_why: The judge text never treats any verse on a 'cited in' line as an unanswered witness, so it does not do the thing the rule governs.
quote: CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN -- [L1] Matthew 1:18 "before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost"
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round
room: Whether Luke 1:34 listed under [L3] is meant as a 'cited in' witness counted as unanswered. Reading one: it is only a link label, so the rule is not triggered. Reading two: it is an implied witness, so the missing round quotation is a breach. The text never calls it unanswered or cites a 'cited in' line, so I took reading one.
why: The judge text lists verses and Greek terms for links but never counts any verse as an unanswered witness, so K-G4's quotation-and-round requirement is never triggered.
